"I'm afraid the General and others like him couldn't appreciate what I'm trying to..."
"I don't care about the General or his opinion!! What did you mean when you said Elina isn't here!?"

"Wait a moment...How did Elina know your name, "
"...I've already told you how you're part of the great change that's coming...How you're caught up in a powerful stream carrying you."
"One of the streams that moves the world is "

"What do you mean, Elina? How can you know these things? And why can't you leave here?"
"...It's because...Because I'm..."
"Transformed...? What are you talking about!?"
"A sacrifice!?"

"...I had "
